Sub-tasks are used to break down a task or story into smaller, individually assignable units of work.

🔹 1. Sub-task Title

  • Prefix with the domain:

    • Documentation

    • Frontend

    • Backend

    • Infra

    • Code review

    • Testing

Example:

[Backend] Create DB migration script for password reset tokens

🔹 2. Sub-task Description

  • Include specific instructions, technical considerations, or edge cases.

Example:

Create a migration script to add a new password_reset_tokens table. The table should include a token string, user ID foreign key, created_at, and expires_at fields.

🔹 3. Completion Criteria

  • Clear, binary conditions for completion.

Example:

  • Migration script created and committed

  • Script tested locally with rollback

  • Reviewed by another backend developer

🔹 4. Assignee

  • Who will execute this exact piece of work?

🔹 5. Checklist (Optional)

Useful if the sub-task involves multiple small steps.
